# SI017 — missing-insufficient-outcome

The verdict space must include an insufficient/unknown outcome.

## Why

Forcing a binary decision on ambiguous evidence increases disagreement and unfairness.

## Bad

```python
VERDICTS = ("VIOLATION", "DISMISSED")
```

## Good

```python
VERDICTS = ("POLICY_VIOLATION", "DISMISSED", "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE")
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI017 -- reason
```
